events.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Como 1, Manchester United 0. Nico Paz (Como) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Lucas da Cunha.
Andrey Santos (Manchester United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match (Como).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
First Half ends, Como 1, Manchester United 0.
Substitution, Manchester United. Amad Diallo replaces Matheus Cunha.
Substitution, Manchester United. Carlos Baleba replaces Andrey Santos.
Goal! Como 2, Manchester United 0. Tasos Douvikas (Como) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Nico Paz with a through ball.
Carlos Baleba (Manchester United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Como 3, Manchester United 0. Nico Paz (Como) left footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom left corner.
Substitution, Como. Maxence Caqueret replaces Martin Baturina.
Substitution, Manchester United. Joshua Zirkzee replaces Bruno Fernandes.
Substitution, Como. Kaiki replaces Lucas da Cunha.
Goal! Como 4, Manchester United 0. Jacobo Ramón (Como) header from very close range to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Kaiki.
Substitution, Manchester United. Harry Amass replaces Matthijs de Ligt.
Substitution, Como. Alberto Dossena replaces Máximo Perrone.
Substitution, Como. Samuele Ricci replaces Nico Paz.
Substitution, Como. Ivan Smolcic replaces Yan Couto.
Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Manchester United. Shea Lacey replaces Bryan Mbeumo.
Shea Lacey (Manchester United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Como 4, Manchester United 1. Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Amad Diallo with a cross.
Second Half ends, Como 4, Manchester United 1.
